feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 26 September 2026 5:35am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing.


##Wind)##

SW 4 or 5, backing S or SW 5 or 6 in the evening.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate in the evening.


##Weather)##

Fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

S or SE 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 for a time in the afternoon, and then veering W by late afternoon. Then gradually decreasing 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, perhaps rough for a time in the afternoon, becoming slight later.


##Weather)##

Area of rain, occasionally heavy, progresses eastwards during the day, becoming fair later.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Monday, 28 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing later.


##Wind)##

W or SW 3 or 4, gradually backing SE, then becoming 4 or 5 early in the night, and gradually increasing 6 or 7 by the end of the night.


##State of sea)##

Slight, building moderate later. Perhaps touching rough in places by the end of the night.


##Weather)##

Fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tuesday, 29 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

SE 6 or 7, decreasing S 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather)##

Some patchy light rain for much of the day. However, a more persistent band of rain will arrive through the evening. This will turn heavy for a time overnight before becoming lighter and patchier towards dawn.


##Visibility)##

Good at first, becoming moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Wednesday, 30 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

S 5 or 6, veering SW 4 or 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, soon decreasing moderate, then slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
